title: artifacts/<product>/modules/<m>/scenarios.json: the scenarios a human described for scenario mode (selectable steps), written only by `run.mjs scenarios` from state/scenario-answers.json. The module-explorer explores only their flows (explore.mjs scope `scenarios`); test cases are enumerated only within them.

id.description: Stable: assigned once per key, never reused.

start.description: Where the scenario starts (a page, a URL or a state the human named).
